import sqlite3,pathlib,json
p=pathlib.Path('/home/appontrack/.ontrack-saas/ontrack-console.sqlite')
db=sqlite3.connect('file:'+str(p)+'?mode=ro',uri=True)
r=db.execute("SELECT revision,answer_policy_json FROM agent_flow_versions WHERE account_id=1 AND site_id=6 AND agent_id=7 ORDER BY revision DESC LIMIT 1").fetchone()
if r:
 cfg=json.loads(r[1] or '{}')
 print(json.dumps({'agent_id':7,'revision':r[0],'auto_answer':cfg.get('auto_answer'),'answer_delay_seconds':cfg.get('answer_delay_seconds'),'response_style':cfg.get('response_style'),'max_call_minutes':cfg.get('max_call_minutes')}))
else:print(json.dumps({'error':'no_published_flow'}))
